rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham’s submission was the commanded act, not a product of his own choice or planning.
rows.anchor: قال له خله من الأسر ( عمل ) ما أمر به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham’s submission is no self-claim: Islam means disowning personal power, so he asks God to establish him in the commanded state.
rows.anchor: ليس بدعوى من قبله لأن حقيقة الإسلام إنما هو التبري من الحول والقوة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One answer says the Prophet called himself the most knowledgeable of God, but no later ruling followed, so it is reported as his saying “I knew.”
rows.anchor: أنا أعلمكم بالله ) ولكن لم يرد بعده شرع فكان يخبر عنه بأنه قال علمت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Qur’an calls the Messenger a believer because faith is knowledge of God, and God’s testimony is fuller than the Messenger’s testimony about himself.
rows.anchor: لأن الإيمان هو العلم بالله سبحانه وتعالى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham’s submission coincided with trial, while the Prophet avoided language that might look like a claim and was thereby protected.
rows.anchor: اقترنت به البلوى ، ونبينا - - يتحرز عما عو صورة الدعوى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham was commanded in a matter expressed through action and surrender; the Prophet was commanded in knowledge, whose subtleties have divisions.
rows.anchor: أمر بما يجري مجرى الأفعال ، فإن الاستسلام به إليه يشير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Although their legal practices differed, Abraham and Jacob taught their sons the same undivided foundation of monotheism and Islam.
rows.anchor: فشرائعهم - وإن اختلفت في الأفعال - فالأصل واحد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God’s choosing the religion for them is glad tidings that strengthens their desire, since they can expect divine aid to make obedience easier.
rows.anchor: بشارة بما تقوي به دواعيهم على الرغبة فيما يكلفهم من الإسلام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Jacob’s family followed one path of monotheism and submission, inherited generation after generation, and were God’s purified people of nearness.
rows.anchor: جروا كلهم - صلوات الله عليهم - على منهاج واحد في التوحيد والإسلام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sons say “your God” rather than “our God” to honor Jacob’s distinction and their own lower station, then attest that they submit to God.
rows.anchor: حيث سلموا له المزية ، ورأوا أنفسهم ملحقين بمقامه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God assigns each person and group a fitting rank and measure; each has its own sphere and its own share of felicity.
rows.anchor: وأفرد لكل واحد قدرا بموجب حكمه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The spiritually elect are few in number in every age, but great in worth.
rows.anchor: كذلك الخواص في كل وقت يقل عددهم ولكن يجل قدرهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who feared Goliath’s army viewed matters outwardly and felt human fear; God steadied their hearts by reminding them that He aids His friends.
rows.anchor: بعين الظاهر فداخلهم شيء من رعب البشرية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Victory comes by God’s will, help, and strength; patience and standing firm come first as God’s due, while victory is the believers’ share.
rows.anchor: لا بهم ولكن بإذن الله ، بمشيئته وعونه ونصرته ، والله مع الصابرين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They sought victory over the unbelievers as God’s enemies, not revenge for their own loss; acting for God and by God brought victory.
rows.anchor: يطلبون النصرة عليهم - لا للانتقام منهم لأجل ما فاتهم من نصيبهم - ولكن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Though Talut’s stature intimidated the enemy, God gave the killing of Goliath to short, slight David, who had only a sling, because divine support was with him.
rows.anchor: لم يكن معه من السلاح إلا مقلاع ، ولكن الظفر كان له لأن نصرة الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God’s turning people against one another prevents the strong from destroying the weak and diverts their harm; this is a favor to all.
rows.anchor: لو تظاهر الخلق وتوافقوا بأجمعهم لهلك المستضعفون لغلبة الأقوياء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Knowledge of these past unseen events did not come from human learning or cleverness; it came through God’s instruction.
rows.anchor: لم يكن في علمك ولا في وسع احتيالك الوقوف على هذه الغائبات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A polytheist who asks protection must be sheltered until hearing God’s speech, then escorted to a place of safety if he does not believe.
rows.anchor: إذا استجار المشرك - اليوم - فلا يرد حتى يسمع كلام الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If an unbeliever receives protection to hear God’s speech, a believer who seeks refuge from separation from God should not be barred from hearing Him.
rows.anchor: فإذا استجار المؤمن طول عمره من الفراق - متى يمنع من سماع كلام الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God’s protection of His friends from separation in the hereafter is a test of them, and the greatest terror will not grieve them.
rows.anchor: كلا . . إنه يمتحنهم بذلك ، قال تعالى : { لا يحزنهم الفزع الأكبر }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If God shows care to those who lack knowledge, His care for those who know is greater; the spiritually bankrupt cannot equal the sincere, or the veiled equal those absorbed in divine presence.
rows.anchor: فإذا كان هذا بره بمن لا يعلم فكيف بره بمن يعلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A poem contrasts the faithful and deficient beloved, concluding that a lover and a hater are never equal.
rows.anchor: وأحبابنا شتان : واف وناقص . . . ولا يستوي قط محب وباغض

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If they remain faithful to the covenant, God grants them intimacy; if they turn from it, He rejects them, and they gain nothing by distance.
rows.anchor: إن تمسكوا بحبل وفائنا أحللناهم ولاءنا ، وإن زاغوا عن عهدنا أبليناهم بصدنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The God-fearing person worthy of divine love fears loving the self, leaves personal advantage, and fulfills the Lord’s right.
rows.anchor: المتقي الذي يستحق محبة من يتقى ؛ وذلك حين يتقي محبة نفسه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their character makes fidelity unlikely: if they gained power over believers, they would honor neither sacred ties nor kinship or covenant.
rows.anchor: فلو ظفروا بكم واستولوا عليكم لم يراعوا لكم حرمة ، ولم يحفظوا لكم قرابة أو ذمة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A noble person forgives when victorious and able, rather than betraying when in power.
rows.anchor: أن الكريم إذا ظفر غفر ، وإذا قدر ما غدر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their pleasing words conceal hearts that reject faith, just as they display faith outwardly while hiding disbelief from God.
rows.anchor: يظهرون لباس الإيمان ويضمرون الكفر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One who accepts anything short of God makes a bad bargain: he neither enjoys God nor finds contentment elsewhere, and remains a clear loser.
rows.anchor: من رضي من الله بغير الله أرخص في صفقته ثم إنه خسر في تجارته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who disregard God’s right cannot be expected to respect believers’ rights; their manners share the same violation of sanctity.
rows.anchor: كيف يراعي حق المؤمنين من لا يراعي حق الله في الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If they become fit for divine loyalty, religious kinship joins them to believers; otherwise, they should remain outsiders.
rows.anchor: فلحمة النسب في الدين بينكم وبينهم وشيجة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When they betray their pledge and attack believers, fight the leaders at the center of the discord, the chiefs of unbelief.
rows.anchor: إذا جنحوا إلى الغدر ، ونكثوا ما قدموه من ضمان الوفاء بالعهد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Prepare strength openly for combat while inwardly disowning personal power; fight in obedience to God, since anger for oneself is blameworthy but anger for God brings near aid.
rows.anchor: وحق القتال إعداد القوة جهرا ، والتبري عن الحول والقوة سرا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Fear of God heralds closeness, while fear of anyone else warns of separation; true fear clears the inner self of disobeying warnings and commands.
rows.anchor: فالخشية من الله بشير الوصلة ، والخشية من غير الله نذير الفرقة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: As God alone creates, He alone provides sustenance.
rows.anchor: بكونه خالقا تفرد بكونه رازقا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Bodily provision is obedience granted to some and failures granted to others; spiritual provision is connection for some, heedlessness and later punishment or respite for others.
rows.anchor: وهو لقوم توفيق الطاعات ، ولآخرين خذلان الزلات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: For the spirits, provision means realities of intimacy for some, but worldly heedlessness and eventual punishment or respite for others.
rows.anchor: وللأرواح رزق : وهو لقوم حقائق الوصلة ، ولآخرين - في الدنيا - الغفلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God’s control of hearing and sight means He perfects some people’s vision through monotheism and blinds others to realization.
rows.anchor: فيكمل بعض الأبصار بالتوحيد ، وبعضها يعميها عن التحقيق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Bringing the living from the dead and the dead from the living means bringing a believer from an unbeliever and an unbeliever from a believer.
rows.anchor: يخرج المؤمن من الكافر ، والكافر من المؤمن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Although they answer God, they speak from conjecture and words without inward conviction.
rows.anchor: لا عن بصيرة ، ونطقا . . لا عن تصديق سريرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: All created things and events are subject to divine will, decree, and power; the decree has already passed and cannot be altered.
rows.anchor: سبق لهم الحكم ، وصدق فيهم القول ؛ فلا لحكمه تحويل ولا لقوله تبديل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Causes cannot alter what is eternal or reverse God’s decree.
rows.anchor: فلا لحكمه تحويل ولا لقوله تبديل ، فإن العلل لا تغير الأزل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He rejects both assigning partners in creation under the doctrine of predestination and denying God’s power to resurrect; both are unbelief.
rows.anchor: قوم جعلوا له في الإيجاد شركاء بدعوى القدر ، وقوم منعوا جواز قدرته على الإعادة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Truth is a divine name: God exists, possesses truth, and makes truth actual; for creatures, truth is good action, sound belief, and permissible speech.
rows.anchor: الحق اسم من أسمائه سبحانه ، ومعناه أنه موجود ، وأنه ذو الحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: To guide someone to truth is to establish him upon truth; the rarest gift is being guided to truth for God’s sake, without personal claim or share.
rows.anchor: فمن هداه الحق للحق وقفه على الحق ، وعزيز من هداه الحق إلى الحق للحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Conjecture favors one judgment without certainty; it is defective regarding God, while certainty about one’s own future is also defective.
rows.anchor: فالظن في أوصاف الحق معلول ، والقطع - في أوصاف النفس - لكل أحد معلول

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A servant should not presume to know his own unseen future, but should have certainty about God; the Prophet and his followers are told to call with insight.
rows.anchor: والعبد يجب أن يكون في الحال خاليا عن الظن إذ لا يعرف أحد غيب نفسه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The heedless grow blinder the more they hear the Qur’an, while people of spiritual realization grow in guidance; God’s address confuses some and enlightens others.
rows.anchor: انسدت بصائرهم فلا يزدادون بكثرة سماع القرآن إلا عمى على عمى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When Joseph lost his father’s immediate care, God gave him revelation; God opens the hearts of His friends to purity and intimacy when He opens a trial.
rows.anchor: حين انقطعت على يوسف عليه السلام مراعاة أبيه حصل له الوحي من قبل مولاه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Enabling a liar to weep at will is a sign of God’s abandonment.
rows.anchor: تمكين الكذاب من البكاء سمة خذلان الله تعالى إياه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: An unattributed report says that when hypocrisy is complete, a person can control his eyes and weep whenever he wishes.
rows.anchor: إذا كمل نفاق المرء ملك عينه حتى يبكي ما شاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Qushayri allows that the brothers may have regretted harming Joseph and wept sincerely, while concealing the reason from Jacob and blaming the wolf.
rows.anchor: لا يبعد أن يقال إنهم وإن جنوا على يوسف عليه السلام فقد ندموا على ما فعلوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their false bloodied shirt did not persuade Jacob; his heart told him the truth, so he called their story a deception and invoked beautiful patience and God’s help.
rows.anchor: لم يؤثر تزوير قالبهم في إيجاب تصديق يعقوب - عليه السلام - لكذبهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The hearts of the truthful sense outcomes generally before their details become clear later.
rows.anchor: وهكذا تقرع قلوب الصديقين عواقب الأمور على وجه الإجمال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They were punished for failing to tear Joseph’s shirt, allowing Jacob to recognize their lie.
rows.anchor: عوقبوا على ما فعلوه بأن أغفلوا عن تمزيق قميصه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A person may receive more than requested: the travelers hoped for water and instead found Joseph; yet they mistook a free person for a slave.
rows.anchor: كالسيارة كانوا يقنعون بوجود الماء فوجدوا يوسف عليه السلام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God stirred the travelers to journey and deprived them of water so they would draw it and free Joseph; worldly commotion may be meant to bring one person calm.
rows.anchor: ألا رب تشويش يقع في العالم ، والمقصود منه سكون واحد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The brothers did not recognize their loss when they sold Joseph cheaply; need later revealed how greatly they had undervalued him.
rows.anchor: لم يعرفوا خسرانهم في الحال ولكنهم وقفوا عليه في المآل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The ships crossing the sea safely signify the vessel of divine enabling, protection, light, and preservation.
rows.anchor: وهي فلك التوفيق والعصمة ، وسفينة الأنوار والحفظ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The nights of seekers are for seeking, those of intimate lovers for ecstasy, and those of penitents for spiritual struggle; knowers need no lamp of learning in the daylight of certainty.
rows.anchor: وكذلك ليالي الطلب للمريدين ، وليالي الطرب لأهل الأنس من المحبين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God gives beyond what people aspire to, ask for, or expect, as the promise to answer supplication confirms.
rows.anchor: أنلناكم فوق ما تؤملون ، وأعطيناكم أكثر مما ترجون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Some reciters read every as nunated and what as a negation, meaning God gave things people never asked for.
rows.anchor: فينون قوله : كل ويجعل ما سألتموه ( ما ) للنفي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The community received gifts before asking through obedience and forgiveness before seeking it through repentance; God knew sinners might be too ashamed to ask.
rows.anchor: أعطيتكم قبل أن تسألوني - وهذا لأرباب الطاعات ، وغفرت لكم قبل أن تستغفروني

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God grants forgiveness before the sinner asks, sparing him the shame of recounting his lapses.
rows.anchor: فأعطاه غفرانه ، وكفاه حشمة السؤال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: No servant could have known before existence what God would prepare for him in gnosis, worship, or sin; a poem says love came before awareness and found an empty heart.
rows.anchor: قبل أن كان له إمكان ، أو معرفة وإحسان ، أو طاعة أو عصيان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Human gratitude is too slight to repay abundant blessings, which neither knowledge nor understanding can enumerate.
rows.anchor: وشكركم نزر يسير ، وإنعامه وافر غزير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Protection from trials and disasters is also a blessing, so favors cannot be counted any more than benefits can be counted.
rows.anchor: فكيف يأتي الحصر والإحصار على ما لا يتناهى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The ability to thank God is itself a blessing; each act of gratitude needs further enabling, leaving no end to the favors owed.
rows.anchor: إن التوفيق للشكر من جملة ما ينعم به الحق على العبد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The world hides sorrow in its pleasures and bitterness in its sweetness; its promises fail, its blessings mingle with harms, and its gifts contain trials.
rows.anchor: نعمها مشوبة بنقمها ، وبؤسها مصحوب بمأفوسها ، وبلاؤها في ضمن عطائها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who rely on possessions and children and forget their Lord lose in this life and regret what they missed in the next.
rows.anchor: من اعتضد بعتاده ، واغتر بأولاده ، ونسي مولاه في أوان غفلاته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Money and sons adorn the heedless, while good works and certainty adorn those joined to God; the former rely on outward display, the latter on worship and knowledge of God.
rows.anchor: زينة أهل الغفلة في الدنيا بالمال والبنين ، وزينة أهل الوصلة بالأعمال واليقين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Whatever gives the self a share is worldly adornment, including status, praise, and familiar attachments.
rows.anchor: ما كان للنفس فيه حظ فهو منزينة الحياة الدنيا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Anything in which a person has a share is defective, whether its consequence arrives now or later.
rows.anchor: ما كان للإنسان فيه شرب ونصيب فهو معلول

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The lasting righteous works are actions marked by sincerity and truthfulness.
rows.anchor: وهي الأعمال التي بشواهد الإخلاص والصدق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One interpretation defines lasting good works as deeds done purely for God, without desire or ulterior purpose.
rows.anchor: ما كان خالصا لله تعالى غير مشوب بطمع ، ولا مصحوب بغرض

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another interpretation makes them divine qualities adorning inward secrets and sending their fragrance through the heavenly realm.
rows.anchor: ما يلوح في السرائر من تحلية العبد بالنعوت ، ويفوح نشره في سماء الملكوت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another interpretation sees them as nearness and noble intimacy already granted to a person from the unseen.
rows.anchor: هي التي سبقت من الغيب له بالقربة وشريف الزلفة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another interpretation calls them the lights of monotheism hidden in the heart, beyond the eclipse of veiling.
rows.anchor: ضياء شموس التوحيد المستكن في السرائر مما لا يتعرض لكسوف الحجبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The earth’s mountains will move when the spiritual substitutes die; through them God now keeps the earth steady, and they are its true pillars.
rows.anchor: بموت الأبدال الذين يديم بهم الحق - اليوم - إمساك الأرض

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: No one escapes death or departure from the world; the saints’ distinction lies in avoiding settled attachment to worldly dwellings.
rows.anchor: ما من أحد إلا ويسقى كأس المنية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At the gathering, each person stands in a distinct spiritual state and wears what fits: piety, passion, ecstasy, love, longing, or intimacy.
rows.anchor: فمن لباس تقوى ، ومن قميص هوى ، ومن صدار وجد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another interpretation says people will be stripped of every quality except the one that held their attention in life.
rows.anchor: يجردهم عن كل صفة إلا ما عليه نظرهم يوم القيامة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The soul does not know the heart’s contents, the heart cannot reach the spirit’s secrets, and the spirit cannot reach the secret’s realities; only God knows what is still more hidden.
rows.anchor: النفس لا تقف على ما في القلب ، والقلب لا يقف على أسرار الروح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: What is deeper than the secret is beyond Satan and the recording angels and is known only to God.
rows.anchor: الذي هو أخفى من السر لا يفسده الشيطان ، ولا يكتبه الملكان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: No created contingent thing independently originates anything; all existence belongs to God by His right to pre-eternity.
rows.anchor: نفى كل موهوم من الحدثان بأن يكون شيء منه صالحا للإبداع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God’s beautiful names are His attributes, divided into attributes of essence and attributes of meaning; they also teach creation His unique transcendence from defects.
rows.anchor: على انقسامها إلى صفة ذات وصفة معنى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The question about God’s names is phrased as an inquiry but intends affirmation and confirmation.
rows.anchor: سؤال في صيغة الاستفهام والمراد منه التقرير والإثبات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Qur’an often follows mention of Muhammad with Moses; God showed Moses the fire to draw him away from his family, though the fire itself was not the true aim.
rows.anchor: ألاح له النار حتى أخرجه من أهله يطلبها ، وكان المقصود إخراجه من بينهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses approached while the fire receded, and left his family to seek a firebrand for them despite the danger of the valley.
rows.anchor: فكان موسى عليه السلام يدنو والنار تنأى ، وقال لأهله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One account says Moses was seized by agitation at the sight of the fire and could not hold himself back from going out.
rows.anchor: استولى على موسى عند رؤيته النار الانزعاج ، فلم يتمالك حتى خرج

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses found a tree burning from end to end, but it would not yield a flame; the fire illuminated hearts rather than bodies.
rows.anchor: هذه النار تضيء ولكن لا تعطي لأحد منها شعلة . يا موسى هذه النار تحرق القلوب لا النفوس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: As Moses tried to take a flame, he heard God’s call and recognized it by its ordered structure and composition.
rows.anchor: علم موسى أنه كلام الحق - سبحانه - لما سمع فيه الترتيب والتنظيم والتركيب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another view says God identified His speech to Moses through special inspiration, without inference.
rows.anchor: بتعريف خصه الحق - سبحانه - به من حيث الإلهام دون نوع من الاستدلال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One explanation says sandals are removed because no one treads with shoes on a king’s court.
rows.anchor: فإن بساط حضرة الملوك لا يوطأ بنعل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The inward meaning of removing both sandals is to empty the heart of concerns about both worlds and devote oneself wholly to God.
rows.anchor: تفريغ القلب من حديث الدارين ، والتجرد للحق بنعت الانفراد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When God intends an event, He arranges its fitting causes; Moses first feared a trial, but the fire led him to prophethood through hidden decree.
rows.anchor: ولو لم تقع تلك الحالة لم يخرج موسى عندها بإيناس النار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God first showed fire and then light, but neither was the aim; the purpose was Moses hearing God say He is Lord of the worlds.
rows.anchor: ولا كان المقصود النار ولا النور . وإنما سماع نداء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Qur’an progressively locates the call at the valley’s right side, the blessed spot, and the tree, concealing the exact place from conjecture while marking its blessing.
rows.anchor: ثم قال : ( في البقعة المباركة ) ثم قال ( من الشجرة )

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The most honored places are where beloved ones are encountered; a poem says love makes the beloved’s dwelling dear.
rows.anchor: وأعز الأماكن في العالم مشهد الأحباب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Many feet had trodden the spot without hearing anything, and many nights passed without its fire yielding a flame.
rows.anchor: كم قدم وطئت لك البقعة ، ولكن لم يسمع أصحابها بها شيئا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Adam’s tree marked the opening of trial, whereas Moses’ tree marked the opening of prophethood and the message.
rows.anchor: شتان بين شجرة وشجرة ؛ شجرة آدم عندها ظهور محنته وفتنته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The tree is left unidentified; an inward reading calls it the tree of intimacy, rooted in love and bearing nearness and spiritual joy.
rows.anchor: بل هي شجرة الوصلة ؛ وثمرتها القربة ، وأصلها في أرض المحبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses fainted at the first call and angels comforted him with intimacy, since the beginner is treated gently; in a later encounter he fell unconscious and was rebuked for seeking vision.
rows.anchor: وهذا كان في ابتداء الأمر ، والمبتدئ مرفوق به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The spiritual path begins with gentleness but ends with severity, as a poem compares it to drinking wine among lions.
rows.anchor: في البداية لطف وفي النهاية عنف ، في الأول ختل وفي الآخر قتل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: An interpretation has God tell Moses to remove his sandals, drop his staff, and stay with Him after his tiring journey; even if not transmitted, it suits the moment.
rows.anchor: يا موسى . . اخلع نعليك وألق عصاك ، وأقم عندنا هذه الليلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If parents press their child toward shirk or a sinful lapse, he must refuse but keep their company kindly, showing a permissible outward face while reserving his inward self for God.
rows.anchor: ولكن عاشرهما بالجميل ؛ تخشين في تليين ، فاجعل لهما ظاهرك فيما ليس فيه حرج

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Follow the person who turns wholly to God, with no remnant of self; whatever is allotted will reach its recipient inevitably.
rows.anchor: وهو المنيب إليه حقا من غير أن تبقى بقية فى النفس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is subtle and fully aware of the fine details of events.
rows.anchor: عالم بدقائق الأمور وخفاياها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The strongest way to command good is to practice what one urges and refrain from what one forbids; one who cannot govern himself cannot govern others.
rows.anchor: وأبلغه أن يكون بامتناعك بنفسك عما تنهى عنه ، واشتغالك واتصافك بنفسك بما تأمر به غيرك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The good to be commanded is whatever brings a servant to God, and the evil to be forbidden is whatever distracts the servant from God.
rows.anchor: ما يوصل العبد إلى الله ، والمنكر الذي يجب النهي عنه هو ما يشغل العبد عن الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A person who stands for God’s right will be tested and must patiently endure for God; whoever is patient for God does not lose by God.
rows.anchor: تنبيه على أن من قام بحق امتحن في الله ؛ فسبيله أن يصبر لله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Do not act proudly toward people: remember that God watches you, and this awareness makes one humble rather than arrogant.
rows.anchor: ومن علم أن مولاه ينظر إليه لا يتكبر ولا يتطاول

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The servant should become absent from self-witnessing and personal power, and detach from the disclosures that have taken hold of the inner self.
rows.anchor: كن فانيا عن شواهدك ، مصطلما عن صولتك ، مأخوذا عن حولك وقوتك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In an inward reading, the donkey’s bray is someone speaking in the language of gnosis without God’s permission; another says it is a Sufi speaking before his time.
rows.anchor: في الإشارة هو الذي يتكلم فى لسان المعرفة من غير إذن من الحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another explanation says a donkey brays when it sees Satan, which is why its voice is the ugliest.
rows.anchor: إنما ينهق الحمار عند رؤية الشيطان فلذلك كان صوته أنكر الأصوات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Creation’s benefits include the sky as a roof, earth as a bed, sun as a lamp, moon for calendar reckoning, and stars for guidance.
rows.anchor: فالسماء لتكون لكم سقفا ، والأرض لتكون لكم فراشا ، والشمس لتكون لكم سراجا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The outward blessings are the blessings themselves, while the inward blessings are witnessing the Bestower; other interpreters distinguish worldly and religious blessings.
rows.anchor: فالظاهرة وجود النعمة ، والباطنة شهود المنعم . والظاهرة الدنيوية ، والباطنة الدينية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Other pairings of outward and inward blessing include a body without sin and a heart without heedlessness, giving and contentment, wealth and purified spiritual states, blessing and protection.
rows.anchor: الظاهرة نفس بلا زلة ، والباطنة قلب بلا غفلة . الظاهرة العطاء ، والباطنة الرضاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Further pairings include successful obedience and its acceptance, sound bodily form and purified character, and righteous companionship with preservation of its honor.
rows.anchor: الظاهرة توفيق الطاعات ، والباطنة قبولها . الظاهرة تسوية الخلق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Further readings contrast worldly renunciation with sufficiency in God, struggle with spiritual witnessing, duties of the ego with subtleties of the heart, and seeking God with finding and remaining with Him.
rows.anchor: الظاهرة توفيق المجاهدة والباطنة تحقيق المشاهدة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Whoever sincerely surrenders to God while doing good grasps the firm handhold and follows the best way.
rows.anchor: ومن يسلم وجهه إلى الله وهو محسن فقد استمسك بالعروة الوثقى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The unbeliever’s return is to God, who knows what is in hearts and will announce their deeds and judge them.
rows.anchor: إلينا إيابهم ، ومنا عذابهم ، وعلينا حسابهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Although they admit God created them when asked, they revert to error and persist in it.
rows.anchor: ولئن سألتهم عن خالقهم لأقروا ، ولكن إذا عادوا إلى غيهم نقضوا وأصروا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Even if every tree became a pen, seas became ink, and all pages and writers were spent, God’s meanings and speech would not be exhausted.
rows.anchor: مانفدت معاني ما لنا معك من الكلام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Human resources and speech run out, while what is with God remains; His eternal word has no end.
rows.anchor: فما عندكم ينفذ وما عند الله باق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Producing little or much is equally effortless for God: He commands Be and brings things into being by power, without exertion or changing purpose.
rows.anchor: لا من الكثير مشقة وعسر ، ولا من القليل راحة ويسر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is the real, existent truth who establishes truth; what is worshiped besides Him arose from nonexistence and may return to it.
rows.anchor: { الله هو الحق } : الكائن الموجود ، محق الحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Israelites accused Moses of a bodily defect because he bathed clothed; God made a rock carry away his clothes, and they saw his body was sound.
rows.anchor: كان رجلا حييا ، وكان إذا اغتسل لا يتجرد ( من ثوبه )

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God cleared Moses of their accusation and made him honored in rank; true esteem is with God, not public approval.
rows.anchor: فبرأه الله مما قالوا وكان عند الله وجيها } في القدر والمنزلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People’s acceptance or rejection has no real weight, especially that of commoners who approve or reject without reason.
rows.anchor: قبول الناس لا عبرة به ولا خطر له ، لا سيما العوام فإنهم يقبلون بلا شيء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sound word is the declaration of God’s oneness, the two testimonies spoken with sincere conviction.
rows.anchor: القول السديد كلمة الإخلاص ، وهي الشهادتان عن ضمير صادق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sound speech produces sound deeds; sincere testimony that abandons shirk repairs worldly actions and secures forgiveness in the next life.
rows.anchor: سداد أقوالكم سداد أعمالكم ، ولقد هون عليكم الأمر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Actions are mentioned before forgiveness because present worldly affairs must be set right before one can turn to afterlife concerns.
rows.anchor: ويقال ذكر { أعمالكم } بالجمع ، وقدمها على الغفران

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One reading supplies the inhabitants of the heavens, earth, and mountains as those to whom the trust was offered; another says God gave them life and reason, as in the speaking earth and heaven.
rows.anchor: هنا إضمار أي : أهل السموات والأرض والجبال . وقيل أحياها وأعقلها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The heavens, earth, and mountains refused the trust because they feared betraying it, while humanity accepted it and betrayed it.
rows.anchor: فأبين أن يحملنها } : أي أبين أن تخن فيها ، { وحملها الإنسان } : أي خان فيها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One interpretation says unbelievers betray the original trust of knowledge through disbelief, while other people betray it through sins of differing degrees.
rows.anchor: فالكفار خانوا في الأصل الأمانة - وهي المعرفة - فكفروا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The heavens’ refusal was compassionate fear rather than pride; they sought release from the trust and God excused them.
rows.anchor: ويقال ( أبين ) إباء إشفاق لا إباء استكبار ، واستعفين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Humanity accepted the trust but did not observe it fully, each according to his own measure.
rows.anchor: قبلها ثم ما رعوها حق رعايتها . . كل بقدره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The trust is interpreted as fulfilling obligations, in their roots and branches.
rows.anchor: الأمانة القيام بالواجبات أصولها وفروعها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another interpretation defines the trust as monotheism in belief and diligent observance of its limits.
rows.anchor: الأمانة التوحيد عقدا وحفظ الحدود جهدا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Adam and his descendants carried the trust, which Qushayri links to God honoring humanity in travel and provision as a reward for excellence.
rows.anchor: لما حمل آدم الأمانة وأولاده قال تعالى : { وحملناهم فى البر والبحر }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Human beings carry the trust through God’s aid, not their own; Adam harmed himself by failing to fear what the heavens and earth feared.
rows.anchor: ويقال حمل الإنسان بالله لا بنفسه . ويقال ظلم نفسه حيث لم يشفق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The heavens and earth feared God’s manifestation of lordship and grandeur, while Adam and his descendants accepted through the manifestation of divine gentleness.
rows.anchor: كاشف السموات والأرض بوصف الربوبية والعظمة فأشفقوا ، وكاشف آدم وذريته بوصف اللطف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Physical bodies cannot carry the trust; hearts can, and Adam carried it because he possessed inward reality, as a poem says wisdom’s mountains are easier than a shirt.
rows.anchor: والحمل إنما تحمله القلوب . وآدم كان صاحب معنى فحمل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Adam aspired to the trust when it was offered, drawing creation’s aspiration away; after they refused, he accepted willingly.
rows.anchor: علق آدم بها همته ، فصرف بهمته جميع المخلوقات عنها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The lam in so that He may punish marks an outcome: hypocrites and idolaters are punished, while God turns in mercy to believing men and women.
rows.anchor: اللام في ( ليعذب ) للصيرورة والعاقبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Worshipers and sinful believers are included among those receiving mercy, since they are neither hypocrites nor idolaters; God has included the sinner among the believers.
rows.anchor: فأين العابدون وذكرهم ؟ ولكنهم في جملة من مضى ذكرهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God needs nothing from unbelievers and does not approve disbelief for His servants; He wants them to belong to Him, since without Him they have no refuge or benefactor.
rows.anchor: فما نفتقر إليكم ؛ إذا نحن أغنياء عنكم ، ولكني لا أرضى لكم أن تبقوا عني

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God answers the servant’s obedience and remembrance with gratitude and remembrance, and magnifies even one step taken for Him.
rows.anchor: إن أطعتني شكرتك ، وإن ذكرتني ذكرتك ، وإن خطوت لأجلي خطوة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When hardship strikes, a person humbles himself and implores God; once relieved, he forgets his earlier prayers, sets up rivals, and returns to unbelief and sin.
rows.anchor: إذا مسه ضر خشع وخضع ، وإلى قربه فزع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Qushayri explains devoutly obedient as standing in prayer or standing for a long time.
rows.anchor: القنوت هو القيام ، وقيل طول القيام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Here the devout are those who fulfill the duties of obedience throughout the night and day, inwardly and outwardly, without laxity.
rows.anchor: القنوت القيام بآداب الخدمة ظاهرا وباطنا من غير فتور ولا تقصير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The rhetorical question asks whether the devout worshiper equals the unbeliever; they plainly do not.
rows.anchor: أمن هو قانت كالكافر الذي جرى ذكره ؟ أي ليس كذلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Fear is of the promised punishment, and hope is for the promised reward.
rows.anchor: ( يحذر ) العذاب الموعود في الآخرة ، ( ويرجو ) الثواب الموعود

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who know cannot equal those who do not: the former occupy the highest virtues and the latter the lowest vices.
rows.anchor: هذا في أعلى الفضائل وهذا في سوء الرذائل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Human knowledge may be acquired or bestowed, called constructed or placed, and divided into proof-based and explanatory forms; religious sciences are demonstrative except what comes through inspiration.
rows.anchor: العلم في وصف المخلوق على ضربين : مجلوب مكتسب للعبد ، وموهوب من قبل الرب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who do good through obedience receive good in this world; excellence means performing all that one can.
rows.anchor: بأداء الطاعات ، ( والإحسان هو الإتيان بجيمع وجوه الإمكان )

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Do not use enemy persecution as an excuse to leave worship: God’s earth is wide, so move somewhere that allows worship to continue.
rows.anchor: فأرض الله واسعة ، فاخرجوا منها إلى موضع آخر تتم لكم فيه عبادتكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Patience means restraining the self from what it dislikes; it is also drinking the cups of decree without resistance or frowning, or exposing oneself to the arrows of trial.
rows.anchor: والصبر حبس النفس على ما تكرهه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command to worship God sincerely means total submission to Him; being first Muslim means first in one’s own time and religious law.
rows.anchor: والإسلام الانقياد لله بكل وجه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A report describes sincerity as a secret between God and His servant, inaccessible to Satan and the recording angels.
rows.anchor: الإخلاص سر بين الله وعبده

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Calling God Forgiving and Merciful gives sinners hope: they need forgiveness, and His mercy is what enables them to receive it.
rows.anchor: لأنهم هم الذين يحتاجون إلى المغفرة ، ولولا رحمته لما وصلوا إلى مغفرته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The one best in speech may be Muhammad, all the prophets, the believers, the imams calling people to God, or the callers to prayer.
rows.anchor: ويحتمل أن يكون جميع الأنبياء عليهم السلام . ويقال هم المؤمنون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A caller to God invites people to rely on God alone, seek no recompense from Him, entrust their affairs to Him, and accept His allotment.
rows.anchor: يدعو الناس إلى الاكتفاء بالله وترك طالب العوض من الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: And does righteous work means the caller practices what he invites others to do.
rows.anchor: أي كما يدعو الخلق إلى الله يأتي بما يدعوهم إليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Callers first learn God’s path, then walk it, then invite others; another view says their own spiritual journey and encounters revealed the path to them before they called others.
rows.anchor: عرفوا طريق الله ، ثم سلكوا طريق الله ، ثم دعوا الناس إلى الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Repel evil with what is better by forgiving rather than repaying, overlooking slips, and giving up retaliation; the enemy then resembles an intimate friend without becoming fully sincere.
rows.anchor: بالعفو عن المكافأة ، وبالتجاوز والصفح عن الزلة ، وترك الانتصاف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This is good conduct in serving God: bear patiently with His servants for His sake, and do not avenge yourself on people.
rows.anchor: تحلم مع عباده لأجله . ومن جملة حسن الخلق في الصحبة مع الخلق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Only those granted patience can reach these virtues and rise from base traits; the highest ranks require enduring hardship.
rows.anchor: لا يقوم بحق هذه الأخلاق إلا من أكرم بتوفيق الصبر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At the first satanic whisper, remember God and turn back before it becomes a thought, resolve, action, sin, and then an entrenched danger.
rows.anchor: فإنك إن لم تخالف أول هاجس من هواجس الشيطان صار فكرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sincere seeking of help and refuge frees a person from Satan; disowning personal power and invoking God brings greater protection, as God says His servants are beyond Satan’s authority.
rows.anchor: إن عبادى ليس لك عليهم سلطان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The revealed signs make the proofs clear and remove the excuse of anyone seeking the way to God.
rows.anchor: أوضح الآيات ، وألاح البينات ، وأزاح علة من رام الوصول

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People variously call the Prophet a sorcerer, madman, or poet; the inward oath is by the sky of monotheism adorned with gnosis, love, and nearness.
rows.anchor: والإشارة فيه إلى القسم بسماء التوحيد ذات الزينة بشمس العرفان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People in the Sufi path face deniers, critics who suspect failure to uphold the law, and rigid literalists unaware of the special states God grants His friends.
rows.anchor: فمن منكر يجحد الطريقة ومن معترض يعترض علىأهلها يتوهم نقصانهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Two poems portray public disagreement: some accuse falsely, while some speak truth without knowing whether they do so.
rows.anchor: فكاذب قد رمى بالظن غيرتكم . . . وصادق ليس يدري أنه صدقا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Turned away from it means diverted from it; opponents kept people away by claiming the Prophet was mad.
rows.anchor: أي يصرف عنه من صرف ، وذلك أنهم كانوا يصدون الناس عنه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The accursed liars are false speakers sunk heedlessly in the darkness of misguidance and ignorance.
rows.anchor: لعن الكذابون الذين هم في غمرة الضلالة وظلمة الجهالة ساهون لاهون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their question about the Judgment Day reflects their denial; their souls cannot settle toward what they reject.
rows.anchor: يسألون أيان يوم القيامة ؟ ؛ يستعجلون بها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The fire’s punishment fits those who lie in deeds through ostentation, in spiritual states through vanity, and in claims about God; they lose the fragrance of sincerity.
rows.anchor: يكذبون في أعمالهم لما يتداخلهم من الرياء ، ويكذبون في أحوالهم لما يتداخلهم من الإعجاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The righteous enjoy a garden of intimacy now and gardens of divine grace later; present nearness is the Lord’s due, while future gifts are their share.
rows.anchor: في عاجلهم في جنت وصلهم ، وفي آجلهم في جنات فضلهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Today they receive God’s allotment with gratitude, and in the hereafter receive varied gifts; what they take now through faith and precision, they will receive directly in the garden at encounter and vision.
rows.anchor: يأخذون نصيبه منه بيد الشكر والحمد ، وغدا يأخذون ما يعطيهم ربهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One view says God taught human speech and that the human meant here is Muhammad; another identifies him as Adam.
rows.anchor: فالإنسان على هذا القول هو محمد . وقيل هو آدم عليه السلام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ordinary human explanation is the ability to address others through likeness and form; for believers and knowers, it is knowing how to address their Lord through speech, breath, tears, longing, and sighs.
rows.anchor: وأما أهل الإيمان والمعرفة فبيانهم هو علمهم كيفية مخاطبة مولاهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sun and moon follow measured courses that mark days, months, and years and end at their appointed term; the suns of gnosis and moons of knowledge likewise rise in hearts by divine decree.
rows.anchor: يجري أمرهما على حد معلوم من الحساب في زيادة الليل والنهار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One lexical distinction calls plants without a trunk stars and those with a trunk trees; another says celestial stars and rooted trees prostrate as signs of the Creator’s majesty.
rows.anchor: النجم من الأشجار : ما ليس له ساق ، والشجر : ما له ساق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God raised and ordered the sky, set its stars, protected it from disorder, and fixed its horizons; He created the balance for fairness in human dealings.
rows.anchor: وخلق الميزان بين الناس ليعتبروا الإنصاف في المعالملات بينهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another interpretation makes the balance justice itself.
rows.anchor: ويقال : الميزان العدل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Do not transgress the balance: keep justice in rights owed to people and God, avoiding oppression and excess; in deeds this means sincerity, in states truthfulness, and inwardly matching the outward without deceit or hidden shirk.
rows.anchor: احفظوا العدل في جميع الأمور ؛ في حقوق الآدميين وفي حقوق الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Establish measure with justice by using the standard you would want applied to you, receiving food and drink without short measure.
rows.anchor: وأقميوا الوزن بالمكيال الذي تحبون أن تكالوا به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The basmalah needs a noble hearing untouched by backbiting and a noble heart undisturbed by heedlessness or absence.
rows.anchor: كلمة عزيزة تحتاج في سماعها إلى سمع عزيز لم يستعمل في سماع الغيبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Inevitable Reality names the Resurrection because it brings each person face to face with the good and evil of their deeds.
rows.anchor: اسم للقيامة لأنها تحق كل إنسان بعمله خيره وشره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The question about the Inevitable Reality magnifies its importance and makes its gravity unmistakable.
rows.anchor: استفهام يفيد التعظيم لأمرها ، والتفخيم لشأنها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Past peoples rejected their messengers and persisted in disbelief until God destroyed them; their stories teach later people to avoid the same behavior.
rows.anchor: فأهلكهم ، وانتقم لأنبيائه منهم . والفائدة في ذكرهم : الاعتبار بهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Punishment for this community is deferred to Resurrection, but spiritual elect may be punished immediately if they expose secrets or neglect proper conduct, losing reverence and risking objection to destiny.
rows.anchor: إذا أشاعوا سرا ، أو أضاعوا أدبا يعاقبهم برياح الحجبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A person granted free time for obedience who fails to thank God or behaves badly may be returned to scattered worldly occupations, spiritually drowned and at risk of divine anger.
rows.anchor: فإذا لم يشكر النعمة ، وأساء أدبه ، ولم يعرف قدر ما أنعم الله به عليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God’s special friends sail safely in the vessel of well-being while worldly occupations churn around them; they expect nothing from people, and people are safe from them.
rows.anchor: فيكونون بوصف السلام ، لا منازعة ولا محاسبة لهم مع أحد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At judgment every person is exposed and held to account, receiving rebuke or punishment according to what is due.
rows.anchor: وفي كل نفس مع هؤلاء القوم محاسبة ومطالبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those given their book in the right hand receive joy and praise; the righteous enjoy a satisfied life now because desires have fallen away, and later because their needs are fulfilled.
rows.anchor: هم - اليوم - في عيشة راضية إذ كفوا مآربهم فدفع عن قلوبهم حوائجهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When truth appears, there is no need or asking; the elect’s present life is contentment, while the next life brings gifts and an invitation to behold God.
rows.anchor: فعيش أولئك في العطاء ، وعيش هؤلاء في الرضاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those given their book in the left hand suffer regret, estrangement, and unanswered cries, yet Qushayri says they are in truth shown mercy through a veil that makes them seem low to themselves.
rows.anchor: وهم في الحقيقة من الله مرحومون ، أسبل عليهم الستر فصغرهم في أعينهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The particle no in the oath is redundant: the oath includes all things seen and unseen, leaving no third category.
rows.anchor: ( لا ) صلة والمعنى : أقسم ؛ كأنه قال : أقسم بجميع الأشياء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The noble messenger’s words are the Qur’an or its recitation; Muhammad is neither poet nor soothsayer, but conveys revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
rows.anchor: وقول الرسول الكريم هو القرآن أو قراءة القرآن . وما هو بقول شاعر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If Muhammad fabricated revelation, God would have restrained and punished him; prophetic protection from falsehood is obligatory.
rows.anchor: والقول بعصمة الأنبياء واجب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Qur’an is a reminder for the God-fearing, a distress for deniers, and the truth of certainty; truth of certainty is certainty itself.
rows.anchor: حق اليقين هو اليقين فالإضافة هكذا إلى نفس الشيء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Differences among knowledge, eye, and truth of certainty concern the quantity and clarity of proofs, whether knowledge is necessary or acquired, and the role of perception.
rows.anchor: وعلوم الناس تختلف في الطرق إلى اليقين خفاء وجلاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God’s name is marked by majesty and beauty; His existence has no beginning, kindness is what people expect, and whatever He decrees is His rightful command.
rows.anchor: الوجود له غير مستفتح ، والموجود منه غير مستقبح ، المعهود منه لطفه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Woe is an expression used when calamity occurs; a cheater is one who gives short measure or weight.
rows.anchor: الويل كلمة تذكر عند وقوع البلاء ، فيقال : ويل لك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Cheaters take full measure when buying and reduce it when selling, in weights, measures, disclosure of defects, judging, paying, and collecting.
rows.anchor: فإذا أخذوا لأنفسهم استوفوا ، وإذا دفعوا إلى من يعاملهم نقصوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Anyone who does not want for a Muslim neighbor what he wants for himself is unfair; the truthful act justly with Muslims and all their associates.
rows.anchor: فمن لم يرض لأخيه المسلم ما لا يرضاه لنفسه فيس بمنصف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Seeing other people’s faults while missing one’s own is a form of cheating; a poem contrasts noticing a speck in one eye while overlooking a tree-trunk in the other.
rows.anchor: فالذي يرى عيب الناس ولا يرى عيب نفسه فهو من هذه الجملة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Demanding one’s own rights without paying others’ rights equally is cheating; a noble person fulfills others’ rights and demands none for himself.
rows.anchor: ومن اقتضى حق نفسه - دون أن يقضي حقوق غيره مثلما يقتضيها لنفسه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who cheat should know they will be resurrected and held accountable for people’s rights; forgetting this judgment in dealings is a loss.
rows.anchor: ألا يستيقن هؤلاء أنهم محاسبون غدا ، وأنهم مطالبون بحقوق الناس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A person who watches God should feel awe now as people will at the gathering, since God’s scrutiny is the same today and tomorrow.
rows.anchor: لأن اطلاع الحق اليوم كاطلاعه غدا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sijjin is interpreted as the seventh and lowest earth, where unbelievers’ records are placed in humiliation and their souls are carried.
rows.anchor: هي الأرض السابعة ، وهي الأرض السفلى ، يوضع كتاب أعمال الكفار هنالك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Other views identify Sijjin as a pit in Hell or a rock in the lowest earth; linguistically, the word is derived from imprisonment.
rows.anchor: ويقال : ( السجين ) جب في جهنم . وقيل : صخرة في الأرض السفلى
